title: Sunday · the Grunion Run, 2012
logline: The run wet-on-wet: the lanterns blooming into the wet paper, the fish a silver bleed, and in the last tier a man in a maroon polo under a coat, come from a shift, and an old dog.

panels.composition: Tier 1: lanterns on a night beach blooming into wet paper, soft-edged.

panels.composition: Tier 2: the surf a silver bleed of fish across the tier.

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays
